name: Lee Eisenberg
role: Traveling dry goods salesman for Dan Eisenberg, Bismarck
bio: Lee Eisenberg traveled for the Bismarck dry goods house of Dan Eisenberg and took orders in Medora in May and October 1884. He came again with a line of dry goods in April 1885.

moments.label: Did considerable business in Medora for Dan Eisenberg

mentions: Lee Eisenberg, of Bismarck, travelling for Dan Eisenberg, was in town Monday and secured a number of orders.
Lee Eisenberg, representing the house of Dan Eisenberg, Bismarck, transacted considerable business in Medora on Saturday. Lee is a rustler.
Lee Eisenberg, of Bismarck, was here Saturday with a line of dry goods.
